docs.text:
Robinson’s collection of Tamil traditions about the Hindu sages, with selections in English from the writings of Tamil sages and moral poets such as Tiruvalluvar and Auvaiyār (London, 1873). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Emmanuel College Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Tamil wisdom : traditions concerning Hindu sages, and selections from their writings · Robinson, Edward Jewitt · 1873, 186 scanned pages. Published 1873; Edward Jewitt Robinson died 1900; the verses are medieval or ancient; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
